TOOLING BURST T5a — run-scoped register card (Run C-9, phase P1; charter agentic_orchestration/gandalf/notes/2026-09-26-illuminated-archive-run-C-9-charter.md § 3). task_id "T5a".

WHY: every brief today starts with the root REGISTER_CARD.md (the H1 register). Run C-9 tests a different register and must carry its own card, without touching the root card or any other run's briefs.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, the lane/render_brief.py paragraph in § 1, and the § 7 row "T5a — run-scoped register card (Run C-9)" (this contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. lane/render_brief.py, lane/run_burst.py, lane/ledger.py, tests/test_render_brief.py, tests/run_t0c.py, tests/t0c_suite_output.txt (the last outside-suite run: READ its FAIL/ERROR block list — those reds are inherited and must stay exactly the same).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib only.

CHANGE (minimal, nothing else):
A. lane/render_brief.py: render(task, type, card_path=None). When card_path is given, its text replaces the root REGISTER_CARD.md text in the same position; otherwise behaviour and output are byte-identical to today.
B. lane/run_burst.py: add register_card_for(run) -> Path returning ROOT/'runs'/run/'REGISTER_CARD.md' when that file exists, else ROOT/'REGISTER_CARD.md'. run() passes it to render (card_path only when it is the run's own file), prints 'REGISTER_CARD: <path>' as the first line of --dry-run output ONLY when the run card is used (so dry-runs of runs without a card stay byte-identical), and adds register_card=dict(path=<path relative to ROOT>, sha256=<sha of that file>) to the ledger.append(...) dict in every case.
C. tests/test_render_brief.py: add tests — (1) default render with no card_path equals the render using the root card path explicitly; (2) a temporary card file passed as card_path appears at the start of the brief and the root card text does not; (3) register_card_for returns the root card for a run name with no card file and the run file when one exists (use a temporary run directory by monkeypatching ROOT or the helper's base path; do NOT create files under runs/); (4) nothing else in the brief changes.
Do NOT edit REGISTER_CARD.md, BURST_RULES.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, SPEC.md, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, MANIFEST.sha256, anything under runs/, or any file not named in A–C.

ACCEPTANCE (write runs/C-9/t3/T5a/acceptance.json with each item's command and result):
- python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_render_brief -v : all green (paste the tail).
- python3 lane/run_burst.py --run C-7 --burst-id PRE-T5a-probe --type TOOLING --task briefs/C-7/BL-2v-b.task.json --dry-run : its stdout must be byte-identical to runs/C-9/evidence/pre_T5a_dryrun_C7_BL-2v-b.txt (compare with cmp; report the result).
- python3 lane/run_burst.py --run C-9 --burst-id T5a-probe --type GENERATE --task briefs/C-9/T5a-probe.task.json --dry-run : first line is 'REGISTER_CARD: runs/C-9/REGISTER_CARD.md' (or the absolute equivalent) and the brief begins with the C-9 card text.
- Do NOT run the full outside suite (the conductor runs it after you, under the shared lock).

Write a one-page runs/C-9/t3/T5a/notes.md (what changed, line counts, any concern). Return files.json listing every file you changed or created with sha256.
RETURN: receipt task_id "T5a"; images = []; calls_used = 0; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
